pages.title: Pack the bags
pages.text: Dad helped me stuff the bags. Ace in tennis whites. Riff with the guitar. Scorch already wearing the banana hat. We were going in.

pages.title: Something in the trees
pages.text: Dad didn't make it a speech. He just said look. Horned frog. Huge. I saw it too.

pages.title: Don't get eaten
pages.text: We ran. The road came apart. I kept up. Dad was behind me, not in my face.

pages.title: Gear falling apart
pages.text: Riff's strap slipped. Scorch's jacket was already trash. Stuff falls off. Dad said hold what you can and keep moving.

pages.title: Hold the line
pages.text: We stopped running. Ace, Riff, Scorch, and me. Dad said hold the line — not because he was watching. Because we were still a crew.

pages.title: The jungle splits us
pages.text: The trees pulled them sideways. I could not see everyone. Dad stayed where I could hear him.

pages.title: Ace goes down
pages.text: Ace hit the dirt. One ball left. Dad said last point still counts. I already knew.

pages.title: Ace vs the horned frog
pages.text: Ace got back up. Tennis balls versus the frog. I watched the whole fight. Dad sat with me. We did not skip to the end.
